name: crew
description: A standing team of expert colleagues for a project: subagents with a profile, a memory and a todo, who review the work at milestones and talk with you one-to-one or in meetings; with the Crew panel: the team with portraits, who is at work and the steps they report, the reports, and meetings drawn as a group chat.
